biotools.summary: The EUCAIM Wizard Tool performs an analysis of data re-identification risks of imaging and clinical data that follow the EUCAIM CDM. It includes and uses an EUCAIM specific configuration of the ARX Data Anonymization Tool (biotools:arx), by supporting a wide variety of privacy and risk models as well methods for analyzing the usefulness of output data.
